description: Library of Google Doodle game archetypes. The MAP stage picks the one whose mechanic best dramatizes the launch. Each archetype has a working HTML skeleton the CODEGEN stage customizes.

archetypes.name: Pony Express (2015)
archetypes.mechanic: Side-scrolling horseback runner. Auto-run to the right; jump between lanes/obstacles; catch good items (mail bags) flying at you and dodge bad ones (bandits/cacti). Score = items caught; distance-based difficulty ramp.
archetypes.controls: Up/Down arrows or W/S to switch lanes; catch by touching good items, avoid hazards.
archetypes.good_for: Anything framed as 'keep up with incoming volume', delivery, throughput, collect-the-right-things while moving fast.
archetypes.art_style: flat vibrant cartoon, bold outlines, wild-west palette, simple side-view sprites

archetypes.name: Magic Cat Academy (Halloween 2016)
archetypes.mechanic: Wave-based defense. Enemies (ghosts) approach from edges, each tagged with a symbol/shape; player draws/selects the matching symbol to zap them before they reach the center. Survive escalating waves.
archetypes.controls: Click/drag to trace a symbol, or click enemies matching the highlighted glyph.
archetypes.good_for: Matching the right response to the right threat, fraud/risk clearing, triage where each item needs a specific correct action.
archetypes.art_style: spooky-cute cartoon, purple/orange night palette, chunky friendly monster sprites

archetypes.name: Cricket (2017)
archetypes.mechanic: Timing-based batting. Balls are pitched at varying speeds; player swings at the right moment; well-timed hits score runs (perfect timing = boundary/6). Miss too many and you're out.
archetypes.controls: Spacebar / click to swing at the right moment.
archetypes.good_for: Precision, timing, 'act at the right moment', converting opportunities, hit-rate metrics.
archetypes.art_style: clean flat cartoon, green pitch, bright simple characters

archetypes.name: Pangolin Love (2017)
archetypes.mechanic: Roll-and-collect platformer. Player rolls through a scrolling level gathering ingredients/tokens and avoiding hazards, building toward a goal quota before time runs out.
archetypes.controls: Left/Right to move, Space/Up to jump; roll into collectibles.
archetypes.good_for: Accumulating resources toward a goal, gathering while avoiding pitfalls, savings/rewards stories.
archetypes.art_style: soft rounded cartoon, warm nature palette, cute animal-style hero sprite

archetypes.name: Doodle Champion Island (Olympics 2021)
archetypes.mechanic: Single arcade sport challenge: a fast score-attack mini-event (e.g. rapid tap/dodge lane game) with a clear scoreboard and a target to beat within the time limit.
archetypes.controls: Arrow keys / click depending on the event; reach the target score before time.
archetypes.good_for: Competitive score-attack, 'beat the benchmark', head-to-head or personal-best framing.
archetypes.art_style: anime-inspired flat color, bright sporty palette, energetic character sprites

archetypes.name: Rise of the Half Moon (2024)
archetypes.mechanic: Turn-based grid/connect game. Place or connect tokens on a small board to form matches/lines that trigger effects; plan a few moves to reach a target within limited turns.
archetypes.controls: Click tiles/cells to place or connect tokens.
archetypes.good_for: Planning, connecting related items, deliberate decisions over a small board, categorization/sorting into groups.
archetypes.art_style: serene minimalist, soft night-sky palette, glowing celestial sprites
